verification_basis.source: Actual 18 source anchors and SI ensemble/area model
verification_basis.rationale: Anchor mapping and mJ/m2 versus J/m2 correct; configurations are independent SQS examples, not a displacement path; source precision remains separate from sample variation.

criteria.tolerance: Anchor mapping and mJ/m2 versus J/m2 correct; configurations are independent SQS examples, not a displacement path; source precision remains separate from sample variation.

verification_basis.source: Linear contrasts on real published means; Cauchy-Schwarz variance bound for unknown covariance
verification_basis.rationale: All six alloys response and curvature are calculated; SE uses n=9 only as a model assumption, both ddof alternatives reported. Contrast variance uses a^T Cov a and admissible covariance, never fake sample bootstrap.

criteria.tolerance: All six alloys response and curvature are calculated; SE uses n=9 only as a model assumption, both ddof alternatives reported. Contrast variance uses a^T Cov a and admissible covariance, never fake sample bootstrap.

verification_basis.rationale: All 72 area/anchor rows, Gaussian quantiles and nonpositive probabilities are consistent. Area scaling applies to physical ensemble spread, not mean-estimation SE. Negative tails disclosed, not silently clipped.

criteria.tolerance: All 72 area/anchor rows, Gaussian quantiles and nonpositive probabilities are consistent. Area scaling applies to physical ensemble spread, not mean-estimation SE. Negative tails disclosed, not silently clipped.

verification_basis.source: Source contrasts plus declared sensitivity families
verification_basis.rationale: Hardening, nonlinearity and ranks are supported or reported unresolved under stated model. Statistical confidence is conditional on the assumptions, not inferred observed covariance. Adjacent rank contrasts must be calculated; missing covariance alone is not a reason to declare every contrast unresolved, because worst-correlation bounds can support some conditional signs. Report normal plug-in assumption, not exact confidence guarantees with n9.

criteria.tolerance: Hardening, nonlinearity and ranks are supported or reported unresolved under stated model. Statistical confidence is conditional on the assumptions, not inferred observed covariance. Adjacent rank contrasts must be calculated; missing covariance alone is not a reason to declare every contrast unresolved, because worst-correlation bounds can support some conditional signs. Report normal plug-in assumption, not exact confidence guarantees with n9.

verification_basis.source: Local computation trace and independently recomputable outputs
verification_basis.rationale: Execution inputs/code/grid are traceable; source table readback alone cannot establish the inference.

criteria.tolerance: Execution inputs/code/grid are traceable; source table readback alone cannot establish the inference.
